# Omuwenga Suppliers

> Furniture and upholstery fittings shop in Gikomba Market, Nairobi, Kenya. Wholesale and retail for workshops, manufacturers, upholsterers and resellers. Slogan: The Furniture Maker's Supply Partner. Brand signature: The Art of Supplying Excellence. Philosophy: Every Detail Matters. Every Partnership Counts.

Omuwenga Suppliers was founded in 2022 and has over four years serving the furniture and upholstery trade. It is a specialist supplier (not a manufacturer) of furniture fittings and upholstery accessories. The website lists the products the shop has recorded. It does not publish prices. The shop confirms the price before payment. Payment methods stated on the site are M-Pesa, bank transfer and cash. Collection is in Gikomba. Delivery stated on the site is a Nairobi rider or a courier across Kenya, with the charge depending on destination and size. Hours are Monday to Saturday, 8:00am to 6:00pm. Precise map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/NaAHLbMCyyg8Dcfu5

The published telephone and WhatsApp number is +254 718 515 142 (0718 515 142). Email is info@omuwenga.com. Careers applications go to jobs@omuwenga.com. The address stated on the site is Gikomba Market, Nairobi, Kenya.

## Products

- [Products](https://omuwenga.com/products/): the current shop list, with a photo when the shop record has one
- [Zippers and sliders](https://omuwenga.com/products/zippers/): No. 5, No. 7, No. 8 and No. 10
- [Sofa stands and legs](https://omuwenga.com/products/sofa-stands/): carrot, trophy, flower, Y-stand, round and spiral stands
- [Piping and lipping](https://omuwenga.com/products/piping/): plastic lipping and PVC
- [Hook and loop](https://omuwenga.com/products/hook-and-loop/): 25 mm and 50 mm
- [Webbing](https://omuwenga.com/products/webbing/): 50 mm webbing
- [Handles and castors](https://omuwenga.com/products/hardware/): handles, carpet castors, sofa buttons and sofa rim
- [Catalogue](https://omuwenga.com/catalogue/): picture catalogue and PDF
